decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposal fails to provide sufficient and conclusive information to demonstrate that the application site does not form part of the dwellings curtilage (16 Gwendolen Avenue) as at 8 February 2012 resulting in the possible redevelopment of a private residential garden, contrary to the guidance set out within paragraph 2.29 of the Housing SPD (2016). The site therefore cannot be regarded as a separate planning unit from No.16 Gwendolen Avenue.
Reason : 2 - The proposal fails to provide sufficient information to demonstrate that the existing garage use is no longer needed, contrary to policy LP7 of the Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 3 - The proposal fails to provide sufficient information to demonstrate adequate details of the provision and access of waste storage for the proposed studio flat contrary to policies LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan (2023) and the Reuse, Recycling and Waste SPD (2025).

Reason : 4 - The proposal, by way of inadequate internal floor space, outlook, daylight/sunlight and private outdoor space would fail to provide satisfactory living conditions for future occupiers in contravention of Local Plan (2023) Policy LP27, the London Plan (2021); and the NPPF (2024).

Reason : 5 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
description: Alterations to existing detached garage to the rear of the site, including its enlargement by erection of a single storey front extension and raising its roof ridge height by 650mm, together with installation of entrance door and windows. Works in connection with the proposed conversion of the garage into a studio flat (Class C3).
